title: 第二十三章 空间世界幸存者证词记录第二十二章 凌峰夫妻的保密协议补充条款
lines: 第二十三章：空间世界幸存者证词记录
宇宙警备司令部，地下三层审讯室b区。
墙面泛着冷硬的金属光泽，隔音层将外界的机械嗡鸣彻底隔绝，只有桌案上的记录仪器发出微不可查的运行声。凌峰坐在单向玻璃后的观察席，指尖无意识地敲击着膝盖——审讯室里那个裹着加厚防护服的身影，是三天前从编号s-7空间裂隙中救回的第七个幸存者，也是目前意识最清醒的一个。
“姓名确认：陈默，32岁，原国家地质勘探队队员，2024年7月在昆仑山腹地失踪，推定进入空间世界时长11个月。”刘佳琪的声音透过通讯器传来，她坐在审讯桌对面，面前摊开的记录板上已经画满了简易的生理体征曲线，“陈先生，我们再次确认，你现在的心率和血压都在安全范围，可以开始了吗？”
防护服的头盔缓缓抬起，露出一张布满沟壑的脸。陈默的眼球上布满红血丝，嘴唇干裂得像是久旱的土地，他盯着桌角那杯冒着热气的营养液，喉结滚动了两下才开口，声音嘶哑得像被砂纸磨过：“你们……真的是地球来的？”
“宇宙警备司令部，负责处理空间异常事件的特殊机构。”刘佳琪推过去一杯温水，“我们已经核实过你的身份，2024年你带队勘探昆仑山脉地质断层时，遭遇突发性空间扭曲，全队五人失踪，对吗？”
陈默的肩膀猛地一颤，像是被这句话钉在了座椅上。他沉默了足足半分钟，才抬手捂住脸，指缝间漏出压抑的呜咽：“小张……小李……他们没撑过来……”
观察席上的凌峰皱起眉。前六位幸存者要么陷入持续性谵妄，要么在复述经历时出现严重的逻辑断层，陈默的情绪反应虽然激烈，却保持着基本的叙事能力。他按下通讯键：“刘医生，引导他从进入空间世界的最初阶段开始说。”
刘佳琪点头，在记录板上标注下“情绪波动明显，记忆连贯性良好”，轻声道：“陈先生，我们需要知道你们进入那个世界后的遭遇，这可能关系到其他失踪者的救援，也能帮我们了解那个空间的规律。”
“规律？”陈默嗤笑一声，笑声里带着浓重的绝望，“那个鬼地方没有规律！我们掉进一片灰色的雾里，指南针、卫星电话全失灵了，连手表的指针都在倒着转。一开始以为是地震引发的磁场异常，直到看见那些树……”
他的呼吸突然急促起来，双手紧紧攥住防护服的袖口，指节因为用力而发白：“那些树长得像放大了几百倍的蜈蚣，树干上全是密密麻麻的脚，还会自己挪动位置。我们亲眼看见一棵‘树’把小张的登山包卷走了，那速度快得像子弹……”
刘佳琪的笔尖在纸上快速滑动，偶尔抬头观察陈默的微表情：“你们当时有没有尝试记录方位？或者观察到光源、地标之类的参照物？”
“没有光源，永远是灰蒙蒙的，像阴天的傍晚。”陈默摇头，额头上渗出冷汗，“我们走了大概三天，食物开始短缺，小李提议原路返回，可回头看时，身后的雾里全是影子，那些影子会跟着人的动作晃，却没有实体……”他突然停住，眼神涣散地盯着前方，“不对，它们有实体。第五天的时候，老王掉队了，我们听见他在雾里喊救命，声音越来越远，最后变成……像是被什么东西嚼碎的声音。”
观察席的记录仪发出“嘀”的一声，凌峰看着屏幕上陈默急剧升高的心率曲线，对身旁的技术员道：“给他注射微量镇静剂，别让他情绪崩溃。”
药剂通过防护服内置的静脉导管注入后，陈默的情绪渐渐平复了些。他喝了口温水，继续说道：“后来我们发现，那个世界的‘地面’不是平的，有时候走着走着，脚下就会变成垂直的岩壁，但我们不会掉下去，像是有股力量把人粘在上面。小张说那是引力异常，可他第二天就被‘风’卷走了。”
“风？”刘佳琪敏锐地抓住这个词，“什么样的风？”
“不是自然风。”陈默的声音带着颤音，“是黑色的风，像墨汁一样，能把接触到的东西腐蚀成灰。那天我们正在找水源，突然听见呼啸声，小张跑得慢了一步，被那风扫到了胳膊，他的防护服瞬间就烂了，皮肤……皮肤像融化的蜡一样往下掉……”他闭上眼睛，声音哽咽，“我拉不动他，只能看着他被风卷进雾里，连骨头都没剩下。”
单向玻璃外，凌峰的手指在桌面上敲出急促的节奏。前几位幸存者也曾提到过“黑色的风”和“会动的植物”，但描述都很模糊，陈默的证词第一次提供了具体的细节。他在笔记本上写下“腐蚀性气流，生物形态异常”，又画了个问号——这些现象是空间世界的固有特征，还是某种未知文明的造物？
“你们是怎么生存下来的？”刘佳琪的声音放得更柔，“根据我们的测算，那个空间的大气成分与地球差异很大，普通人很难在没有防护的情况下存活超过72小时。”
陈默抬起头，眼神里闪过一丝异样的光：“我们找到了一个‘气泡’。”
“气泡？”
“像肥皂泡一样的东西，透明的，里面的空气能呼吸。”他比划着，“大概有足球场那么大，里面长着一种发光的苔藓，能照亮周围。我们在里面待了八个月，靠苔藓的孢子和偶尔从雾里飘进来的……奇怪的鱼活着。”
“没有眼睛，身体是半透明的，飘在‘气泡’的上层，像水母一样。”陈默的语速加快，“那里面不止我们，还有其他人。有个穿军装的老人，说他是1976年在罗布泊失踪的；还有个小姑娘，手里攥着2008年奥运会的门票……”
凌峰的眼神一凛。不同年代的失踪者出现在同一个空间，这印证了之前的推测——那个空间世界可能存在时间紊乱，不同时空的人类会被随机卷入。
“那个‘气泡’是安全的吗？”刘佳琪追问。
“一开始是。”陈默的脸色又沉了下去，“但它会收缩。我们刚进去的时候，边缘离中心有几十米，后来每天都在变小，发光苔藓也越来越暗。穿军装的老人说，这像是能量在耗尽。”他顿了顿，喉结滚动着，“最后一个月，‘气泡’的边缘开始出现裂缝，黑色的风从缝里钻进来。小李为了抢最后一块苔藓，被裂缝吸出去了……”
审讯室里陷入死寂，只有记录仪器的嗡鸣在回荡。陈默低着头，肩膀微微耸动，防护服的头盔上凝结着细小的水珠，分不清是汗水还是泪水。
刘佳琪轻轻敲了敲桌面：“陈先生，你还记得离开‘气泡’后的事吗？我们是在距离‘气泡’遗址三公里的地方发现你的。”
陈默猛地抬起头，眼神里充满惊恐：“别让我想！那些影子……它们在‘气泡’破了之后围过来了！它们没有形状，却能说话，说着不同年代的语言，像无数人在耳边喊……”他突然捂住耳朵，身体剧烈颤抖，“它们想把我拉进雾里，我拼命跑，看见一道光……然后就什么都不知道了。”
“光？”刘佳琪追问，“什么样的光？”
“白色的，很亮，像门缝里透出来的……”陈默的声音越来越低，眼神重新变得涣散，“那光里有人影……穿着和你们一样的衣服……”
观察席上的凌峰按下暂停键，对技术员道：“把刚才关于‘光’和‘人影’的片段标记出来，和前六位幸存者的证词做交叉比对。”他起身走到窗边，看着审讯室里被医护人员搀扶着离开的陈默，眉头紧锁。
刘佳琪推门进来时，正好看见他对着记录板沉思。板上贴满了便签，上面写着“时间紊乱”“空间气泡（能量场）”“黑色气流（腐蚀性）”“影子生物（意识体？）”等字样，用红线串联起来，形成一张复杂的关系网。
“生理指标显示他的精神状态濒临崩溃，后续需要持续心理干预。”刘佳琪递过一份报告，“但他的证词可信度很高，尤其是不同年代失踪者共存这一点，和我们在空间裂隙附近检测到的多频段时间残留完全吻合。”
凌峰指着“空间气泡”的便签：“能量场耗尽导致收缩，这说明那个空间世界可能存在某种能量循环，而‘气泡’是不稳定的能量聚合体。”他又指向“影子生物”，“能模仿人类语言，具有攻击性，这更像是某种意识集合体，而非自然生物。”
“还有那个‘光’。”刘佳琪补充道，“前六位幸存者里，有两位也提到过类似的白光，但都没陈默说得这么具体。他说光里有人影穿着我们的制服，会不会是……”
“我们的人。”凌峰接过话，眼神锐利，“或者说，未来的我们。”他转身看向监控屏幕上陈默被送往隔离病房的背影，“通知技术部，加大对s-7裂隙的能量监测，重点捕捉白光信号。另外，把所有幸存者的证词整理成报告，尤其是关于‘气泡’和‘影子生物’的细节，我要在明天的晨会上看到。”
刘佳琪点头应下，目光落在记录板最下方的便签上，那里写着一行字：“空间世界是否存在智慧文明？其目的是什么？”
审讯室的灯光缓缓熄灭，只留下记录仪器的屏幕还亮着，映照着满墙的便签和红线，像一张等待被解开的巨大谜题。而在遥远的s-7空间裂隙另一端，灰色的雾霭依旧弥漫，那些隐藏在雾中的秘密，正随着幸存者的证词，一点点浮出水面。

Chapter 23: Testimonials of Space World Survivors
Space Security Command, Area B of the interrogation room on the third underground floor.
The wall has a cold metallic luster, and the sound insulation layer completely blocks the hum of machinery from the outside world. Only the recording equipment on the desk makes an inaudible sound. Ling Feng sat in the observation seat behind the one-way glass, tapping his knees unconsciously with his fingertips - the figure in the interrogation room wrapped in a thick protective suit was the seventh survivor rescued from the space rift numbered S-7 three days ago, and he is also the most conscious one currently.
"Name confirmation: Chen Mo, 32 years old, former member of the National Geological Survey Team. He disappeared in the hinterland of the Kunlun Mountains in July 2024. It is estimated that he entered the space world for 11 months." Liu Jiaqi's voice came through the communicator. She sat across from the interrogation table. The record board spread out in front of her was filled with simple physiological signs curves. "Mr. Chen, we have confirmed again that your heart rate and blood pressure are within the safe range. Can we start?"
The helmet of the protective suit slowly lifted up, revealing a face full of ravines. Chen Mo's eyeballs were covered with red bloodshot eyes, and his lips were as chapped as dry land. He stared at the steaming cup of nutrient solution on the corner of the table. His Adam's apple rolled twice before he spoke. His voice was hoarse as if it had been sandpapered: "Are you... really from the earth?"
"Cosmic Security Command, a special agency responsible for handling abnormal space events." Liu Jiaqi pushed over a glass of warm water. "We have verified your identity. In 2024, when you led a team to explore geological faults in the Kunlun Mountains, you encountered a sudden space distortion and five people in the team disappeared, right?"
Chen Mo's shoulders trembled suddenly, as if he was nailed to his seat by these words. He was silent for half a minute, then raised his hands to cover his face, a suppressed sob leaked from between his fingers: "Xiao Zhang... Xiao Li... they didn't make it..."
Ling Feng frowned in the observation seat. The first six survivors either fell into persistent delirium or had serious logical gaps in their retelling of their experiences. Although Chen Mo's emotional reaction was intense, he maintained his basic narrative ability. He pressed the communication button: "Doctor Liu, guide him from the initial stage of entering the space world."
Liu Jiaqi nodded, marked "Obvious mood swings, good memory coherence" on the record board, and said softly: "Mr. Chen, we need to know what happened to you after entering that world. This may be related to the rescue of other missing people, and it can also help us understand the laws of that space."
"Rule?" Chen Mo sneered, with a heavy sense of despair in his laughter, "There is no pattern in that damn place! We fell into a gray fog, the compass and satellite phone all failed, and even the hands of the watch were spinning backwards. At first, I thought it was an abnormal magnetic field caused by the earthquake, until I saw those trees..."
His breathing suddenly became rapid, and he clenched the cuffs of the protective suit with both hands, and his knuckles turned white from the exertion: "Those trees look like centipedes magnified hundreds of times. The tree trunks are full of densely packed feet, and they can move on their own. We saw with our own eyes that a 'tree' swept away Xiao Zhang's hiking bag, and it was as fast as a bullet..."
Liu Jiaqi's pen tip slid quickly on the paper, occasionally raising her head to observe Chen Mo's micro-expression: "Did you try to record the position at that time? Or observe reference objects such as light sources and landmarks?"
"There is no light source, it is always gray, like a cloudy evening." Chen Mo shook his head, cold sweat broke out on his forehead, "We walked for about three days, and food began to run short. Xiao Li suggested returning the same way, but when he looked back, the fog behind him was full of shadows, and those shadows would follow people's movements. "It's shaking, but there is no entity..." He suddenly stopped and stared ahead with his eyes distracted, "No, they have entities. On the fifth day, Lao Wang fell behind. We heard him calling for help in the fog, and his voice became farther and farther, and finally turned into a sound like being chewed by something. "
The recorder in the observation area beeped. Ling Feng looked at Chen Mo's sharply rising heart rate curve on the screen and said to the technician beside him: "Inject him with a small amount of sedatives to prevent him from having an emotional breakdown."
After the medicine was injected through the intravenous catheter built into the protective suit, Chen Mo's mood gradually calmed down. He took a sip of warm water and continued: "Later we discovered that the 'ground' of that world was not flat. Sometimes when walking, the feet would turn into vertical rock walls, but we would not fall. It was as if there was a force sticking people to it. Xiao Zhang said it was a gravitational anomaly, but he was swept away by the 'wind' the next day."
"Wind?" Liu Jiaqi grasped the word keenly, "What kind of wind?"
"It's not a natural wind." Chen Mo's voice was trembling. "It's a black wind, like ink, which can corrode everything it touches into ash. We were looking for water that day when we suddenly heard a whistling sound. Xiao Zhang ran a step slower and was caught by the wind. It hit his arm, and his protective suit instantly rotted, and his skin... his skin fell down like melted wax..." He closed his eyes, his voice choked, "I couldn't pull him, and I could only watch him being swept into the fog by the wind, with no bones left. "
Outside the one-way glass, Ling Feng's fingers tapped a rapid rhythm on the table. Previous survivors had also mentioned "black wind" and "moving plants", but the descriptions were vague. Chen Mo's testimony provided specific details for the first time. He wrote "corrosive airflow and abnormal biological forms" in his notebook, and drew a question mark - are these phenomena inherent characteristics of the space world, or the creation of some unknown civilization?
"How did you survive?" Liu Jiaqi's voice became softer. "According to our calculations, the atmospheric composition of that space is very different from that of the earth. It is difficult for ordinary people to survive for more than 72 hours without protection."
Chen Mo raised his head, a strange light flashed in his eyes: "We found a 'bubble'."
"Bubbles?"
"Something like a soap bubble, transparent, with breathable air inside." He gestured. "It's about the size of a football field. There is a kind of luminous moss growing in it, which can illuminate the surroundings. We stayed in it for eight months, surviving on the spores of the moss and the... strange fish that occasionally drifted in from the fog."
"Fish?"
"There are no eyes, and the body is translucent, floating on the top of the 'bubble', like a jellyfish." Chen Mo spoke faster, "It's not just us, there are others. There is an old man in military uniform who said he disappeared in Lop Nur in 1976; there is also a little girl holding a ticket for the 2008 Olympics..."
Ling Feng's eyes flashed. Missing people from different eras appear in the same space, which confirms previous speculations - there may be time disorder in that space world, and humans from different time and space will be randomly involved.
"Is that 'bubble' safe?" Liu Jiaqi asked.
"Yes at first." Chen Mo's face darkened again, "But it will shrink. When we first entered, the edge was tens of meters away from the center. Then it became smaller every day, and the glowing moss became darker and darker. The old man in military uniform said that it seemed like the energy was running out." He paused, his Adam's apple rolling, "In the last month, cracks began to appear on the edge of the 'bubble', and black wind got in through the cracks. Xiao Li was sucked out by the cracks in order to grab the last piece of moss..."
The interrogation room fell into dead silence, with only the hum of the recording equipment echoing. Chen Mo lowered his head and shrugged his shoulders slightly. There were tiny drops of water on the helmet of the protective suit. It was hard to tell whether it was sweat or tears.
Liu Jiaqi tapped the table lightly: "Mr. Chen, do you remember what happened after you left the Bubble? We found you three kilometers away from the Bubble site."
Chen Mo suddenly raised his head, his eyes full of fear: "Don't let me think! Those shadows... they came around after the 'bubble' burst! They have no shape, but they can speak, speaking the language of different eras, like countless people shouting in his ears..." He suddenly covered his ears, and his body trembled violently, "They wanted to pull me into the fog. I ran as hard as I could, and saw a ray of light... and then I didn't know anything."
"Light?" Liu Jiaqi asked, "What kind of light?"
"White, very bright, like the light coming from the crack of the door..." Chen Mo's voice became lower and lower, and his eyes became distracted again, "There are figures in the light... wearing the same clothes as you..."
Ling Feng, who was in the observation seat, pressed the pause button and said to the technician: "Mark the clips about 'light' and 'figure' just now, and cross-compare them with the testimonies of the first six survivors." He stood up and walked to the window, frowning as he looked at Chen Mo who was being helped away by the medical staff in the interrogation room.
When Liu Jiaqi opened the door and came in, she happened to see him meditating on the clipboard. The board is covered with sticky notes, with words such as "Time Disorder", "Space Bubble (Energy Field)", "Black Airflow (Corrosive)", "Shadow Creatures (Conscious Body?)" written on them, connected in series with red lines, forming a complex network of relationships.
"Physiological indicators show that his mental state is on the verge of collapse, and he will need continuous psychological intervention in the future." Liu Jiaqi handed over a report, "But his testimony is very credible, especially the coexistence of missing people from different eras, which is completely consistent with the multi-frequency time residues we detected near the space rift."
Ling Feng pointed to the note on the "space bubble": "The exhaustion of the energy field leads to contraction, which shows that there may be some kind of energy cycle in that space world, and the 'bubble' is an unstable energy aggregate." He then pointed to the "shadow creature", "It can imitate human language and is aggressive. It is more like some kind of consciousness collection than a natural creature."
"And that 'light'." Liu Jiaqi added, "Two of the first six survivors also mentioned a similar white light, but neither was as specific as Chen Mo. He said there was a figure wearing our uniform in the light, could it be..."
"Our people." Ling Feng took the words with sharp eyes, "Or, we in the future." He turned to look at the back of Chen Mo who was sent to the isolation ward on the monitoring screen. "Inform the technical department to increase the energy monitoring of the S-7 crack and focus on capturing the white light signal. In addition, compile the testimonies of all survivors into a report, especially the details about 'bubbles' and 'shadow creatures'. I will see it at tomorrow's morning meeting."
Liu Jiaqi nodded in agreement, and her eyes fell on the note at the bottom of the record board, where a line of words was written: "Is there an intelligent civilization in the space world? What is its purpose?"
The lights in the interrogation room slowly went out, leaving only the screen of the recording instrument still on, reflecting the notes and red lines all over the wall, like a huge puzzle waiting to be solved. On the other side of the distant S-7 space rift, the gray mist is still filled, and the secrets hidden in the mist are emerging little by little with the testimonies of survivors.
